About Us

Support That Starts With a Conversation, Not a Form

Registered NDIS Provider

Delivering trusted disability support services across Perth

We do not believe in handing people a standard package and calling it support. Before anything is put in place, we sit down with you and your circle to talk through what actually matters: routines, goals, the things you want to manage yourself, and where extra help would make a real difference.

The name Bunjil reflects steady, protective support. As a Registered NDIS Provider, our team includes registered nurses, support coordinators, mentors and in-home support workers trained in manual handling, medication support, complex care and cultural safety.

Our Mission

Fewer barriers, more choice, and support that adds something real to daily life.

Our mission is straightforward: to help people with disability live the life they want, with the support they need to get there. We listen first, plan second, and keep reviewing because goals and circumstances change.

Our Services

NDIS supports across Perth and the Swan Valley

From everyday in-home help to clinical nursing care and support coordination, we shape each service around the participant, their routines and their goals.

Selected service

Assisted living

Accommodation-based support for people who need help with cooking, cleaning, personal care, budgeting, routines and staying safe at home.

Core Values

What participants and families can expect every time they work with us

Our NDIS support services are built around dignity, independence, and community inclusion across Perth.

1

Respect & Cultural Sensitivity

We provide NDIS disability support that respects each participant’s culture, identity, beliefs, and personal preferences to ensure truly inclusive care.

2

Empowerment & Independence

We support individuals to live more independently by building everyday living skills, confidence, and self-reliance.

3

Inclusivity & Community Connection

We help participants stay connected with their community in Perth through social participation, local activities, and meaningful engagement.

4

Compassion & Quality Care

We deliver compassionate, person-centred disability support services with attention to safety, dignity, and wellbeing at every step.

5

Integrity & Accountability

We operate with transparency, reliable communication, and consistent NDIS-compliant care that families can trust.

6

Innovation & Progress

We continuously improve our support services using modern care practices to deliver better outcomes for participants.
